definitions.explanation: One of a pair of ears, or something that applies to only one ear. Commonly used when discussing earphones, hearing, or accessories worn on a single side.

examples.japanese: {片耳|かたみみ}だけイヤホンをつけた。
examples.english: I put an earphone in just one ear.

examples.japanese: {片耳|かたみみ}が{聞|き}こえにくくなった。
examples.english: It became hard to hear in one ear.

examples.japanese: {周|まわ}りの{音|おと}にも{気|き}を{配|くば}れるように、{片耳|かたみみ}だけイヤホンをして{走|はし}ることにしている。
examples.english: I make it a rule to run with an earphone in just one ear so I can stay aware of the sounds around me.

notes:
Composed of {片|かた} (one of a pair) and {耳|みみ} (ear). The prefix {片|かた} is productive in Japanese for indicating one of a paired set: {片手|かたて} (one hand), {片目|かため} (one eye), {片足|かたあし} (one foot/leg).

Most commonly used in modern contexts when discussing earphones or earbuds, as well as hearing loss affecting one side.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {片耳|かたみみ}イヤホン: single-ear earphone
- {片耳|かたみみ}が{聞|き}こえない: deaf in one ear
- {片耳|かたみみ}だけつける: to wear in one ear only
- {片耳|かたみみ}{用|よう}: for one ear; single-sided

RELATED TERMS:
- {両耳|りょうみみ}: both ears — the counterpart to {片耳|かたみみ}
- {片目|かため}: one eye — same {片|かた} pattern
- {片手|かたて}: one hand — same {片|かた} pattern
